Home.headline: Inspect a used-car listing before you go see it.
Home.intro: Start with the listing URL. Kontroll separates claims, open checks, and evidence.

Submission.label: Listing URL
Submission.explanation: Report access is saved privately in this browser. The page address alone does not grant access.
Submission.invalidUrl: Enter a secure listing URL beginning with https://.
Submission.requestFailed: The analysis could not be started. Try again.
Submission.pastedHint: Paste the seller's listing text when the page cannot be read. Labeled facts such as Make: and Year: help identify the car.
Submission.fallbackDescription: Start the analysis, then add the pasted description and screenshots.
Submission.inspectionWaiting: Waiting for a complete HTTPS listing address.
Submission.inspectionAuto24: Auto24 recognized. The listing is ready for automatic capture.
Submission.inspectionFallback: HTTPS accepted. Description and screenshots may be needed.
Submission.inspectionInvalid: This address cannot be inspected. Use a complete HTTPS address.
Submission.manualTitle: Create a report from your information
Submission.manualIntro: Paste the listing text. After opening the private report, you can add screenshots and seller replies. The listing will not be fetched.

offline.noCopy: No saved copy is available on this device.
offline.savedWarning: Saved on {date}. This copy may be out of date.
offline.saveTitle: Keep a copy on this device
offline.accessDenied: Open the private report link again, then try saving.
offline.storageFull: This device is out of storage. Free up space and try again.
offline.unavailable: Saving isn't available in this browser.
offline.offlinePending: Saved on this device, but offline access is not ready. Keep this page open and try again.
offline.saveFailed: Could not save this report. Try again.
offline.removeFailed: Could not confirm the saved report was fully removed. Try again.
offline.iphoneWarning: On iPhone, Safari can delete saved reports after 7 days without a visit. Add Kontroll to the Home Screen to keep them.

access.heading: Opening the inspection report
access.deniedExplanation: Open the original private report link to view this analysis.
access.explanation: Keep this page open while the private access link is checked. If it does not open, reload the original link.
access.unavailableExplanation: Reload this private link to try again.

status.partial: Initial report ready; further checks are running

activity.stale: We cannot confirm processing is still active. Your partial findings are saved.
activity.stopped: Processing has stopped. Your partial findings are saved.
activity.queued: Waiting to start. Your findings will appear as they become available.
activity.ready: Your review is ready to read.

Report.confidencePending: Recommendations appear after the evidence review is complete.

findings.heading: Still needs checking
findings.intro: Resolve these points before agreeing to travel, pay a deposit, or buy.
findings.empty: No unresolved checks are present in the current report.
findings.waiting: Checks will appear after the initial information has been processed.

seller.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select all text in the field below and copy it manually.

checklist.heading: At the viewing
checklist.intro: Tick these off while you inspect and test-drive the car.

supplement.heading: Add seller information
supplement.intro: Add seller answers, maintenance documents, or extra images. Readable PDF contents are included in the final assessment. All supplied material remains unverified.
supplement.filesHint: Add up to eight JPEG, PNG, WebP, or PDF files.
supplement.success: Information added. The report is updating.
supplement.updated: Information added. The report is up to date.
supplement.updateFailed: Information added, but the report could not be updated.
supplement.invalid: Add an answer or at least one file.
supplement.tooManyFiles: Add no more than eight files.
supplement.failed: The information could not be added. Try again.

review.heading: Evidence review

state.pending: Waiting to review the supplied information.
state.running: Reviewing the supplied text and images. Initial checks remain visible.
state.incomplete: AI review is incomplete. Initial checks remain available.
state.disabled: AI review is disabled. This report contains initial checks only.
state.complete: The supplied information has been reviewed. Seller material remains unverified.

review.retryFailed: Could not restart the review. Try again.

compact.counts: {findings, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}} · {photos, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}}
compact.methodology: Findings retain their original descriptions and evidence. Listing and seller claims remain unverified unless corroborated; photos cannot establish the full condition of a vehicle.
compact.photoLimitations: Seller and listing claims remain unverified unless corroborated. Photo review does not replace an in-person inspection.

taustakontroll.heading: Add taustakontroll PDF
taustakontroll.intro: Upload the Maanteeamet / Transpordiamet vehicle background check while photos are being reviewed, or later. Completed photo reviews are kept; only the final assessment is updated. Uploaded documents remain unverified.
taustakontroll.processed: PDF included in the updated assessment.
taustakontroll.updateFailed: PDF received, but the assessment could not be updated.
taustakontroll.tooLarge: Choose a PDF smaller than 12 MiB.
taustakontroll.uploadFailed: The PDF could not be uploaded. Try again.
taustakontroll.invalidPdf: This PDF could not be read. Upload an unlocked PDF with selectable text.
taustakontroll.accepted: PDF received. Waiting for the final assessment.

deck.label: Report cards
deck.coverLede: {count, plural, =0 {No open checks in this report.} one {One thing to check before you go.} other {# things to check before you go.}}
deck.messageIntro: {count, plural, one {One request} other {# requests}} for the seller, ready to paste into Auto24.

Diagnostics.title: Live diagnostics
Diagnostics.offline: Connection lost. Saved data may be out of date.
Diagnostics.timingNote: Attempt duration includes preparation and saving. Parallel photo attempts overlap.
Diagnostics.expiredLease: Worker lease expired. This attempt may no longer be progressing.
Diagnostics.reusedFrom: Reused from run {run}, completed {completed}. No new model call.
Diagnostics.provisional: Provisional findings — final assessment is pending.
Diagnostics.resultUnavailable: Saved findings could not be loaded.
Diagnostics.counts: {complete}/{selected} photos reviewed · {running} running · {waiting} waiting · {unavailable} unavailable · {skipped} skipped
Diagnostics.photoTimingNote: Phases overlap and nested times are included in their parent. Times are not added together.
Diagnostics.queueRetryUnavailable: Queue and retry waits: not recorded separately.
Diagnostics.reusedPreparation: Saved review reused. Preparation shown below belongs only to this run.
Diagnostics.reviewerPreparationMissing: Reviewer retrieval and PNG preparation: not recorded locally. Remote image preparation is not measured.

capture.title: Listing capture timings
capture.note: Waits come from saved queue times. Work phases are measured by the capture worker.

availability.unavailable: Capture timings could not be loaded.
availability.not_applicable: Not applicable. This report was made from pasted text.
availability.disabled: Capture timings are off in the extraction service.

capture.omitted: {count} timing updates were not saved, so some phases may be missing.
